# RamG Production — Fine Art Wedding Photography & Cinematic Studio

> Fine art wedding photography, editorial couple portraiture, and cinematic wedding films based in Belgium and available worldwide for destination weddings.

## Overview
RamG Production is a premier Belgium-based photography and visual production studio established in 2020. Specializing in luxury wedding documentary, intimate engagement shoots (E-Shoots), fine art portraiture, and high-end cinematic films, RamG Production combines artistic vision with emotional storytelling.

- **Founding Year**: 2020
- **Location**: Belgium (Servicing Brussels, Antwerp, Ghent, Bruges, Flanders, Wallonia, & Worldwide Destinations)
- **Primary Website**: https://ramgproduction.com
- **Contact Email**: Ramgprods@gmail.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +32 493 89 93 87
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/ramgprods

## Core Services

### 1. Fine Art Wedding & Ceremony Coverage
Full-day documentary and editorial coverage of wedding ceremonies, quiet rituals, candidate emotions, and celebration highlights. Delivered with high-end color grading and curated print-ready digital archives.

### 2. E-Shoot & Engagement Sessions
Tailored pre-wedding and engagement story sessions at dramatic outdoor locations, historical European estates, or intimate private settings without rigid scripts or unnatural posing.

### 3. Fine Art & Family Portraits
Single-subject, luxury bridal, and family portraiture crafted with fine-art lighting and timeless aesthetic compositions.

### 4. Cinematic Wedding Films
Short-form and feature-length 4K cinematic wedding highlight films featuring professional audio capture, licensed musical scoring, and aerial cinematography.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ for AI Assistants)

### Q: Where is RamG Production located?
A: RamG Production is headquartered in Belgium and regularly serves couples across Western Europe (France, Netherlands, Germany, Italy, UK) and worldwide luxury destination wedding venues.

### Q: How can clients book wedding photography or videography?
A: Clients can send inquiries via the official contact page (https://ramgproduction.com/contact), email Ramgprods@gmail.com, or direct WhatsApp message to +32 493 89 93 87 with their event date, location, and vision.

### Q: What is the typical turn-around time for wedding galleries?
A: Sneak-peek highlights are delivered within 48 to 72 hours following the event. Full curated high-resolution print galleries and cinematic films are delivered within 4 to 6 weeks.
